newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shangri-La to hold EGM on share swap.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-La to hold EGM on share swap.

text.p: Shangri-La Hotel Ltd said on Monday that it will hold an extraordinary meeting on September 14 to obtain shareholder approval for a share swap with Allgreen Properties Ltd despite the latter's move not to list on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES).
Both Shangri-La and Allgreen are companies controlled by Malaysian tycoon Robert Kuok.

On Friday Allgreen said it has withdrawn its application for a listing on the SES. A statement issued by Allgreen's banker DBS Bank said the company decided to withdraw its application "in view of market conditions".
Shangri-La plans to swap its 10.05 percent shareholding in Midpoint Properties Pte Ltd in exchange for new shares in Allgreen, the holding company of Midpoint Properties.
